question:
Select the word that has the same meaning (SYNONYM) as the underlined word in the given sentence.

The prisoners were living in __appalling__ conditions.
solution:
The correct answer is: **shocking**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"appalling"** means something that is horrifying or terrible; it describes conditions that are extremely bad or shocking. (भयानक)

 
 
• **Example: **The news of the disaster was **appalling **and left everyone in shock.
 
 
 
• **"Shocking" **refers to something that causes intense surprise, disgust, or horror; it is similar to appalling in that it describes extreme negative reactions. (चौंकाने वाला)
 
 
• **Example: **The **shocking **revelation about the corruption scandal made headlines.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'appalling' **is **'shocking'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **shocking**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Daring **(साहसी): Willing to take risks; bold.

 
 
• **Example:** His **daring **rescue of the trapped hikers was widely praised.
 
 
 
• **Ingenious **(अद्भुत): Very clever or inventive.
 
 
• **Example: **She came up with an **ingenious **solution to the complex problem.
 
 
 
• **Risky** (जोखिम भरा): Full of risk; dangerous.
 
 
• **Example:** Investing in that startup was a **risky **decision.
